hebrewText: מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּ/יָפְי֖/וֹ תֶּחֱזֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ תִּרְאֶ֖ינָה אֶ֥רֶץ מַרְחַקִּֽים

tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.kjv: (a-, dwell in, very) far (country, off). See also H1023 (בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק).
